Transparent table-banking underwriting standards approved by committee.
A member's maximum borrowing limit cannot exceed 300% of their verified savings balance. Applications exceeding this ceiling are flagged and require an active Chama guarantor.
The estimated monthly repayment (EMI) must not consume more than 45% of total household income to prevent member default and hardship.
Members with an active default history (Credit_History = 0.0) or unpaid fines are prohibited from new loan disbursements until all arrears are resolved.
All table-banking loans are amortized at a fair 10% annual reducing-balance interest rate with fixed monthly installments.
